title: Project configuration — lean-business capability
description: Formal shape of the project's `.pkit/capabilities/lean-business/project/config.yaml` (lean-business DEC-002 point 1): the capability's own configuration. `location` is the folder that holds the project's ideas, one folder for each idea, relative to the repository's top. The first command that writes an idea records it (COR-049 point 5); until then the location is read as `lean-business/`. Which paths the location may take, inside the repository, outside `.pkit/` and outside any hidden folder, is the capability's check's to hold, not this schema's. Document-shaped schema: the file IS the resource. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023): `lean-business:config`.

location.description: The folder that holds the project's ideas, relative to the repository's top, written with `/`.
